title: The diner
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, empty American highway at night, headlight glare on wet asphalt, deep navy darkness with amber and vivid yellow accents, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 3. The waitress knew about her. She'd seen drivers like me before. ☕

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: a different state, the same woman in the same yellow raincoat, at the same mile marker. His dashcam showed an empty shoulder.
scenes.image: a figure in a yellow raincoat walking along a dark highway shoulder far behind a parked semi truck

scenes.narration: Ray didn't sleep in the truck that night. He drove to an all-night diner off the interstate and ordered coffee he didn't want.
scenes.image: lonely roadside diner at night, warm glowing windows, a single semi truck parked in the lot

scenes.narration: The waitress had grey braids and a voice like gravel. She poured, studied his face, and said: you saw her. The one in yellow.
scenes.image: a middle-aged waitress with grey braids pouring coffee into a mug at a diner counter, warm light

scenes.narration: Ray almost laughed. She didn't. She sat down across from him, which waitresses never do.
scenes.image: a waitress sitting in a diner booth across from a tired trucker, two coffee mugs between them

scenes.narration: Every few months, she said, a driver walks in looking like you. White as paper. Talking about mile marker forty-one.
scenes.image: close-up of the waitress's weathered, serious face under a diner pendant lamp

scenes.narration: Ray asked who she was. The waitress shrugged. Nobody knows. But the ones who pick her up never get where they were going.
scenes.image: a trucker's hands wrapped around a coffee mug on a diner table, steam rising

scenes.narration: They end up somewhere else. A town that isn't on their route. A road they never meant to take. Some call home from places they can't explain.
scenes.image: an unfamiliar empty small-town crossroads at night in fog, a truck's headlights approaching
a diner payphone hanging off its hook, swaying slightly, in a dim corner

scenes.narration: She refilled his cup. Whatever you do, honey, don't let her in. And if you do, do exactly what she says.
scenes.image: the waitress standing by the booth with a coffee pot, looking out the dark window behind him

scenes.narration: Ray looked out the window. The marker by the diner's driveway said forty-one. And standing under it, she was smiling at him.
scenes.image: view through a diner window at night, a young woman in a yellow raincoat standing by the roadside in the rain, smiling
